# inject: function reference (not call) removes it from conversion set
inject G f
-- x.go --
package p

var G int

func f() { g(); h() }
func g() { println(G) }
func h() { println(G) }

var fn = g
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,8 +2,8 @@

 var G int

-func f() { g(); h() }
-func g() { println(G) }
-func h() { println(G) }
+func f()      { g(); h(G) }
+func g()      { println(G) }
+func h(g int) { println(g) }

 var fn = g
